rci1_using_msad.detail: ABIDE TD cohort used for normative model transfer is multi-center; normative model constructed on HCP-D and transferred to ABIDE TD.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "The ABIDE database provides a large number of samples obtained from multiple centers."

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP-D and ABIDE (EPDs) used for normative modeling (HCP-D training; ABIDE TD transfer).
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "A normative model for the gradient values was constructed using the HCP-D dataset and then transferred to the TD group of the ABIDE dataset."

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABIDE-I/II and Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D).
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Two large-scale independent datasets from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE)... were analyzed." "To construct a normative developmental trajectory, we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset."

rci5_n.detail: Normative developmental trajectory constructed using HCP-D TD cohort; model then transferred to ABIDE TD.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "To construct a normative developmental trajectory, we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; male/female counts reported for HCP-D do not sum to total N (652).
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "These participants (aged 5-21 years [14.44 ± 4.06, mean ± standard deviation], 301 males and 251 females) represent TD individuals..."
